title: AlignAudio: A Unified Dual-Alignment Framework for Noise-Robust Speech-Conditioned Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech-conditioned generation maps speech signals to target audio outputs. Prior end-to-end speech-conditioned generative models achieve high fidelity in clean acoustic conditions, but their performance degrades substantially under environmental noise. While prior noise-robust approaches have achieved significant success in feature-level purification, maintaining consistent generation under clean and noisy conditioning remains a key challenge. To address this, we propose AlignAudio, a noise-robust generative framework based on dual alignment: (i) aligning the representations of clean and noisy speech to preserve semantic cues, and (ii) enforcing generation-level consistency within a flow matching paradigm to improve conditioning fidelity. Experiments on speech-to-audio (STA) and voice conversion (VC) tasks demonstrate that AlignAudio maintains performance comparable to baselines on clean speech while significantly outperforming them ac

translated_title: AlignAudio：一个用于噪声鲁棒语音条件生成的统一双重对齐框架
translated_abstract: 语音条件生成是指将语音信号映射为目标音频输出。以往的端到端语音条件生成模型在干净声学条件下能够实现高保真度，但在环境噪声下性能会显著下降。尽管先前的噪声鲁棒方法在特征级净化方面取得了显著成功，但在干净和噪声条件下保持一致的生成效果仍然是一个关键挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AlignAudio，一个基于双重对齐的噪声鲁棒生成框架：（i）对齐干净语音和噪声语音的表示以保留语义线索，（ii）在流匹配范式内强制实现生成级一致性以提高条件保真度。在语音到音频（STA）和语音转换（VC）任务上的实验表明，AlignAudio在干净语音上保持了与基线相当的性能，同时在噪声条件下显著优于基线（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了AlignAudio框架，通过对齐干净与噪声语音表示以及流匹配范式下的生成级一致性双重对齐机制，实现了在干净和噪声条件下均保持高保真度的噪声鲁棒语音条件生成。
en_tdlr: AlignAudio is a noise-robust speech-conditioned generation framework that maintains high-fidelity generation under both clean and noisy conditions through dual alignment: aligning representations of clean and noisy speech and enforcing generation-level consistency within a flow matching paradigm.
